title: Atari Lynx
description: A .lnx cartridge or a BS93 object, written as the whole file in order: each stretch the boot ROM and the cartridge's loaders copy to RAM (a BS93 object's one block) a ca65 segment linked at its RAM address, the rest bytes of their own segments (the header, the encrypted first stage the boot ROM decrypts, the directory, padding, unloaded blocks). Suzy's and Mikey's registers by their documented names; an ld65 configuration lays the segments out in file order.
